description.subtitle: Reusch Compressive Compressive Pirate Goalkeeper Meshes - Black
description.intro: Reusch 3/4 Compression Femur goalkeeper meshes combine a compression fit with reinforced protections on thighs and knees to face with greater confidence the impacts during workouts and matches. Its tight and flexible construction adapts to the body as a second skin, favoring the mobility of the goalkeeper.
key_benefits: Reinforced protection: Padded pads protect thighs and knees from impacts on falls and stretches.
Compressive Clamp: The tight fit wraps the muscles and provides a stable feeling during play.
Maximum mobility: Its flexible construction adapts to the body to accompany the movements of the doorman without limiting actions.
Safe fit: The elastic waistband with non-slip belt helps keep the meshes correctly positioned during the activity.
